javax.microedition.broadcast
Class BroadcastServiceException

java.lang.Object
  java.lang.Throwable
      java.lang.Exception
          javax.microedition.broadcast.BroadcastServiceException
All Implemented Interfaces:
java.io.Serializable
Direct Known Subclasses:
InsufficientResourcesException
public class BroadcastServiceException
extends java.lang.Exception

BroadcastServiceException is thrown by a function when an error occurs due to some broadcast service related problems. The exact problem is dependent on the context of the function in question. A printable error message can be obtained by calling the getMessage method from the Throwable superclass.
